audit.limitations: One audited development page and ten corrections. This is diagnostic evidence only and is not a held-out benchmark or promotion audit.
audit.method: Independently checked every proposed target against the full unmarked page image, the frozen audited word sequence, and the correction text and context. Candidate or historical placement boxes were not opened or used. Repeated text was resolved only from correction context and reading order.
